This is a mid-level backend software engineering role (2+ years of experience) at Robinhood, working on the brokerage, incentives, or identity teams that support trading infrastructure, user rewards platforms, and KYC/fraud prevention systems. The work centers on designing and operating scalable backend services and data systems behind Robinhood's consumer finance products. The core stack is Go or Python with Kafka or similar streaming technologies and large-scale data processing, with Postgres, Kubernetes, Redis, and AWS as adjacent technologies.
